pr_body:
In delta-rs we also parse config keys that are uppercase, this provides more flexibility and allows people to use same storage options for delta-rs and pola-rs.

Additionally instead of raising for non existing config keys, we just filter them out. This would make it easier to keep engine specific keys in the storage options in python, since delta-rs has some of those to handle mounted storage.

- closes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19849

issue_context.title: Scan_delta parameters are now lowercase since 1.14.0 for S3
issue_context.body:
### Description

Maybe it also applies for Azure and GCP

```
storage_options = {
    "AWS_REGION": "eu-central-1",
    "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID": "THE_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
    "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY": "THE_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
}
```

Since this change, the keys are now lowercase:
https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/19103

```
storage_options = {
    "aws_region": "eu-central-1",
    "aws_access_key_id": "THE_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
    "aws_secret_access_key": "THE_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
}
```

or you will get

```
polars.exceptions.ComputeError: unknown configuration key: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
```


### Link

https://docs.pola.rs/api/python/stable/reference/api/polars.scan_delta.html

review_comments: Now invalid keys are silently ignored? That doesn't seem right.

I am doing it explicitly. In delta-rs for example we use quite some custom storage_options for our internal log/objectstore handling.

So when you do a read_delta and you pass those additional options from your DeltaTable object into pola-rs, it will error out, see this comment https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/19103#issuecomment-2483144270
Right, can you add a comment that some keys are read upstream and may silently be ignored there.
